major_cooldowns.name: Army of the Dead
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast pre-pull as your single biggest cooldown and trigger for Raise Abomination, Summon Gargoyle, and Apocalypse Now, then keep it on cooldown and synced with Bloodlust and your on-use trinket.

major_cooldowns.name: Dark Transformation
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press on cooldown and macro it into Army of the Dead so Commander of the Dead stays synced; with Outnumber, time it to add spawns for the Lesser Ghoul Sweeping Claws cleave.

major_cooldowns.name: Apocalypse
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast on cooldown to burst your stacked Festering Wounds and summon ghouls; this entry is talent-gated.

major_cooldowns.name: Summon Gargoyle
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Summon during your Army of the Dead burst window so its damage scales with your cooldown buffs; only taken in the Gargoyle build.

major_cooldowns.name: Unholy Assault
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use to generate burst Festering Wounds and a haste buff inside your cooldown window; only taken in builds that talent it.

defensives.name: Anti-Magic Shell
defensives.usage_rule: Press proactively before incoming magic damage to absorb it and generate Runic Power; use it on cooldown as a damage filler when no big magic hit is expected.

defensives.name: Icebound Fortitude
defensives.usage_rule: Use for a major 30% damage reduction and stun immunity ahead of heavy physical tankbusters or unavoidable raid damage.

defensives.name: Lichborne
defensives.usage_rule: Activate to become immune to charm, fear, and sleep effects and to enable Death Coil self-healing during dangerous windows.

defensives.name: Death Pact
defensives.usage_rule: Press as an emergency heal for a large instant chunk of health when you drop low; only available when talented.

defensives.name: Anti-Magic Zone
defensives.usage_rule: Drop on the group before a heavy raid-wide magic hit to reduce magic damage taken for everyone standing inside; only available when talented.

rules.description: Sync Dark Transformation with Army of the Dead
rules.action: Macro Dark Transformation into Army of the Dead and press the first Dark Transformation as soon as it is available after each Army cast so Commander of the Dead empowers all your summoned pets.

rules.description: Opener: Army pre-pull then burst sequence
rules.action: Raise your ghoul and cast Army of the Dead before the pull, then open with Dark Transformation, your on-use trinket and combat potion, two Death Coil or Necrotic Coil casts, and Putrefy.
Cast Death Coil (or Epidemic in AoE) the moment you gain a Sudden Doom proc; it is your strongest non-cooldown button and feeds your Unholy talent interactions.

rules.description: Maintain Lesser Ghoul stacks for Scourge Strike
rules.action: Cast Festering Strike whenever you have no Lesser Ghoul stacks, then spend the stacks with Scourge Strike so Scourge Strike keeps summoning ghouls.

rules.description: Hold a Putrefy charge for Dark Transformation
rules.action: When playing Reaping, bank one Putrefy charge for each Dark Transformation window to save the global and rune you would otherwise spend re-applying it.

rules.description: Skip manual Putrefy below 35% with Soul Reaper
rules.action: While the target is under 35% health with Soul Reaper and Reaping talented, stop hard-casting Putrefy and let Soul Reaper consume your charges instead.

rules.description: Use Death and Decay and Epidemic at 3+ targets
rules.action: At three or more stacked targets, lay Death and Decay when enemies will stay in it and prioritize Epidemic over Death Coil to spend Runic Power as cleave.

rules.description: Stand inside your own Death and Decay
rules.action: Stay inside your Death and Decay during AoE so your Scourge Strike and ghoul attacks gain its cleave; reposition it with the targets if they move.

source_summary: Unholy Death Knight is a burst-focused spec whose damage is concentrated in cooldown windows, so the defining skill is keeping Army of the Dead and Dark Transformation on cooldown and synced together for Commander of the Dead. Between windows you manage Runes, Runic Power, and Lesser Ghoul stacks: spend Sudden Doom procs instantly, keep Festering Strike feeding Scourge Strike, and bank Putrefy charges for Dark Transformation. Align your biggest summons with Bloodlust, trinkets, and potions so every pet benefits from your stacked burst.
